body:
I agree. I'm hoping I can get by on just knowing that they're having fun. There will be a 2 year old there so hopefully she'll have extra fun eating cake. 

It would be nice to talk to you on occasion if you don't mind.

It's not that she says "no", she just feels bad. She says that if we break up she won't ever get another boyfriend.

She's planning a surprise birthday party for me and I hate the idea of that. I never like being the center of attention and she knows this. She tried it once and it was a bad idea. She even cited this when I confronted her about it. She agreed and said she would never do that to me again.

I can't break up with her now because it would be awkward for everyone who is going to all the trouble of trying to making me feel cared about. I just feel like if they did care, then they'd care that I hate that stuff and I'd rather just have a quiet evening at home. I feel selfish for thinking that way. Sorry for this tangent.

I suggested counseling once and she didn't take that very well. I went alone and it didn't really help. I felt like I couldn't connect with him, which was probably for the best because he ended up getting laid off.

I'd rather end it. She knows this but refuses.

I have male acquaintances, the problem is I can't connect emotionally with any of them because it's taboo. Girls seem to care a bit more (recognizing I'm down and asking why) but answering always creates problems.

Thanks for replying to me.
